description: This file defines the PricingClient class for interacting with the AWS Price List Service, including method signatures for retrieving service details, attribute values, price list URLs, products, and price lists, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: PricingClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Price List Service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: describeServices
methods.description: Retrieves information about supported AWS services.

methods.name: describeServicesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about supported AWS services.

methods.name: getAttributeValues
methods.description: Obtains attribute values relevant to pricing.

methods.name: getAttributeValuesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously obtains attribute values relevant to pricing.

methods.name: getPriceListFileUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for the price list file.

methods.name: getPriceListFileUrlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the URL for the price list file.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products information from the pricing API.
